decisive_items: patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis
marked nuclear pleomorphism with atypical mitotic figures

infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm, mixed inflammatory infiltrate, marked nuclear pleomorphism with atypical mitotic figures, vascular involvement, and areas of parenchymal necrosis
response.rationale: R5 directly captures the core diagnostic evidence (large atypical lymphoid cells, pleomorphism, mitotic figures) and already includes necrosis within its spans. C1 is an append-only completion that merely restates the same raw spans without adding any new evidence or altering the diagnosis.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion; all supporting raw spans are already present in R5, and the added 'with necrosis' does not change the diagnosis or provide independent evidence.
